speeches.title: “How Strategy Engineers Digital Credit”
speeches.summary: His explainer on how Strategy turns Bitcoin into two products: MSTR equity and STRC credit.
speeches.quote: Bitcoin is Digital Capital. MSTR is Digital Equity. STRC is Digital Credit.

speeches.title: Keynote: digital credit
speeches.summary: Makes the case that Bitcoin-backed digital credit is Bitcoin’s next big application, walks through how STRC is built, and where banks and funds could plug in.
speeches.quote: We are really excited to provide a stable platform for everyone else to build on top of it.

speeches.title: “The Power of 21”
speeches.summary: Revisits his 21-year model a year on and argues that time plus Bitcoin is the engine of generational wealth.
speeches.quote: You possess the most valuable information in the world — and a rare opportunity to commercialize that insight over the next 21 years.

speeches.title: “21 Ways to Wealth”
speeches.summary: Twenty-one short principles for building wealth around Bitcoin, from conviction and courage to corporate structure and communication.
speeches.quote: Bitcoin is capital, perfected, programmable, and incorruptible.

speeches.title: “The Case for Corporate Bitcoin Adoption”
speeches.summary: His pitch for why public companies should capitalize on Bitcoin, with Strategy’s record since August 2020 as the case study.
speeches.quote: If a company can’t grow organically 15% per year, institutional investors lose interest and liquidity in the firm’s equity & options dissipates.

speeches.title: “Strategic Bitcoin Reserve: A Strategy for U.S. Digital Supremacy”
speeches.summary: His proposal for how a U.S. Strategic Bitcoin Reserve could be built and why he thinks it matters for national power.
speeches.quote: The Strategic Bitcoin Reserve (SBR) should add between $3 trillion and $106 trillion to the U.S. Treasury by 2045.

speeches.title: “21 Truths of Bitcoin”
speeches.summary: Twenty-one one-line definitions of Bitcoin, building from ideology and protocol up to digital energy and defense.

speeches.title: “The Bitcoin Revolution”
speeches.summary: Introduced his 21-year model of global assets and Bitcoin, with playbooks for individuals, companies and nations.
speeches.quote: If you wish to understand the universe, think in terms of energy, frequency, and vibration.

speeches.title: “21 Rules of Bitcoin”
speeches.summary: Twenty-one rules, part aphorism and part philosophy. One of his most-shared talks.
speeches.quote: Bitcoin is the singularity where science collides with economics.

speeches.title: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money
speeches.summary: A four-hour conversation on inflation, energy, property and Bitcoin. His most-watched long-form interview.
speeches.quote: So, the bigger trick is not to move a billion dollars from here to Tokyo. The big trick is to move a billion dollars from here to the year 2140.

speeches.title: The first bitcoin purchase
speeches.summary: The announcement of MicroStrategy’s first bitcoin purchase, which started the Bitcoin treasury era.
speeches.quote: Bitcoin is digital gold – harder, stronger, faster, and smarter than any money that has preceded it.
